item.title: 📢 SALT Centre Level 3 Gym – Temporary pause of Walk-In Sessions
item.description: Dear Students, Please be informed that walk-in gym sessions at the SALT Centre Level 3 Gym will be temporarily unavailable with immediate effect due to the current haze situation. The gym will be prioritized for CCA activities that have been relocated indoors as a precautionary measure. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding and cooperation during this period. We will notify all students once walk-in gym sessions are able to resume. Thank you for your patience and understanding. Regards, SALT Department

item.title: [Action by 26 Oct] 2026 Student Survey on AI in Teaching and Learning
item.description: Dear Students, A gentle reminder to complete the 2026 Student Survey on AI in Teaching and Learning by Monday, 26 October 2026 , if you have not already done so. Survey link: https://forms.gle/wRA595xMCqTiyKZB9 Thank you to those who have already responded. We appreciate your feedback. Warm Regards, Dr. Chow On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 at 8:30 AM Chow Chiu Wai <chowcw@hci.edu.sg> wrote: [This message is bcc'd to all high school students] Dear Students, We would like to hear about your experiences with AI in teaching and learning this year, including what has helped your learning, the challenges you have encountered, and how AI can better support your learning. Your feedback will help the school understand students’ experiences and perspectives, identify useful practices, and inform how AI is used effectively and responsibly in teaching and learning. Please complete the 2026 Student Survey on AI in Teaching and Learning by 26 October 2026 . The survey will take approximately 10 to 12 minutes. Thank you for taking the time to share your views. -- Warmest regards, Dr. Chow Chiu Wai 周钊纬 Director Education Technology Tel: 6578 664 4 • Ext 6641 Live with Passion, Lead with Compassion 自强不息 • 己立立人 己达达人 • 饮水思源 661 Bukit Timah Road Singapore 269734 ❯❯❯ www.hci.edu.sg CONFIDENTIALITY: If this email has been sent to you by mistake, please notify the sender and delete it immediately. item.title: [ECG] RMG Frontline Service Experience Programme (FSEP) 2027
item.description: Dear Students Raffles Medical Group will be launching 2027 Frontline Service Experience Programme (FSEP) programme soon! Students who are keen to gain work experience in the private healthcare industry while waiting to enter university next year can apply for this programme. We aim to give students insights on clinical operations, where they get experience working frontline. They will be attached to either one of our Raffles Medical Clinics or at Raffles Specialist Centre.
